notes: Mother 1 only: Ninten's record (max HP u16 0x030031D2, max PP 0x030031D4, Offense/Defense u16 0x030031D6/D8, Fight/Speed/Wisdom/Strength/Force bytes 0x030031DB-DF, level 0x030031E0, HP 0x030031E4, PP 0x030031E6). Values were read on the status screen, not yet seen changing; Mother 2 (EarthBound) uses other RAM, so these fields are labelled Mother 1
